messages:
ella_cs: Newhaven just sent over their onboarding security pack. They want DPA answers + SOC2 scope confirmation + a short KMS/BYOK note. Also asked about embeddings retention/pseudonymization. Deadline = Tue EOD.
support-bot: uploaded newhaven_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (shared)
arthur_security: ok — can draft attestation + KMS note. Quick Q: do they require FIPS/HSM wording or generic KMS attestation?
ella_cs: they called out HSM in the questionnaire but said "confirm in a single paragraph". Keep it concise.
nina_legal: for SOC2 scope we should confirm which prod tenants are in-scope vs non-prod. Ask them which tenant IDs they consider prod. We can give a standard response if they don't specify.
omar_eng: for embeddings retention we have two policies: Hosted = 30 days by default for transient vectors unless customer requests longer; Dedicated/Private can adjust retention. Pseudonymization: we can support token-level hashing before storage on request.
arthur_security: draft snippet for KMS: "Redwood uses HSM-backed key management for Hosted deployments; for Dedicated/Private customers may supply BYOK. Key rotations occur annually or after incident; rotation and access events are logged to our centralized audit system. Redacted provenance samples available on request."
ella_cs: great. Nina, can you confirm legal-approved SOC2 wording we should use? We need a one-liner about scope + our control environment.
nina_legal: use this: "Redwood Inference maintains SOC2 Type II controls covering availability, confidentiality, and security for our hosted inference service. Customer-specific tenancy and dataflows determine in-scope assets; please provide tenant identifiers for explicit scoping." Good?
ella_cs: yes. I'll assemble answers: DPA Qs, KMS attestation, SOC2 one-liner, and an embeddings retention paragraph. I'll ask Newhaven to confirm tenant IDs if they want explicit SOC2 scope.
support-bot: uploaded files: newhaven_answers_draft.txt, newhaven_kms_attestation.txt, newhaven_embeddings_retention_note.txt
omar_eng: small note on pseudonymization: we can offer a pre-storage salted hash pattern (we'll provide hashing guidance in the answer) but it is not reversible. call out implications for search/semantic similarity.
ella_cs: good point — I'll mention tradeoffs. Posting answers now and will log their feedback in the onboarding tracker. If they escalate BYOK/network peering we'll route to infra and sales for timeline/estimate. Thanks all :pray:
